Promotion Overview

Character advancement item path

Promotions are a character advancement path tied to Promotion Tokens and older reward sources. Current archive entries mostly reference Promotion Tokens as donation, roulette, and reward items rather than a newly changed core mechanic.

Guide Note

Avoiding unsupported details

The available patch-note archive does not provide a clean current promotion requirement table in the same way it does for prestige, race points, or the talent tree. This page therefore keeps the confirmed token and reward references without inventing promotion costs or exact unlock values.
